_fixture: Synthetic example for UI development; not real data. Tables only, so indicators is empty; fetch the tables by run id.

algorithm.description: Ljung-Box, Durbin-Watson, Jarque-Bera and ARCH-LM tests on the in-sample residuals of seasonal ETS and ARIMA fits to the imbalance price.

tables.sample: The gap-free stretch the models were fitted to: its first and last period, its length and how many periods of the range were left out
tables.ljung_box: Ljung-Box Q statistic, degrees of freedom and p-value per model at lags 1..K
tables.tests: Durbin-Watson, Jarque-Bera and ARCH-LM statistics with p-values per model; a not_computed row explains a model that could not be tested

algorithm.limitations: Retrospective: parameters are estimated on the whole stretch, so residuals are never features. Statistics and p-values only, with no pass/fail threshold. P-values below about 1e-16 show as 0.

param_descriptions.models: Settings of each fitted model, as in price_forecast_backtest
param_descriptions.model_df: Fitted AR + MA terms per model, subtracted from the Ljung-Box degrees of freedom
param_descriptions.ljung_box_lags: Largest Ljung-Box lag in periods (48 = one day)
param_descriptions.arch_lags: Lags of squared residuals in the ARCH-LM regression
param_descriptions.max_periods: Most recent gap-free periods each model is fitted to (2688 = 56 days)
